# Cross-platform integration

Cell-line harmonization (DepMap ID / name mapping) and drug-class aggregation (HMA, BCL2i) follow the same rules as HMA_BCL2_Expanded. This section documents **data availability by source** for the StemAI stem-like framework.

```{r integration-status, cache = FALSE}
if (!requireNamespace("here", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("here")
source(here::here("scripts", "stemai_config.R"), local = TRUE)
if (file.exists(STEMAI_WORKSPACE_RDS) && file.size(STEMAI_WORKSPACE_RDS) > 1000) {
  ws <- tryCatch(readRDS(STEMAI_WORKSPACE_RDS), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(ws)) for (nm in names(ws)) assign(nm, ws[[nm]], envir = .GlobalEnv)
}

have_gdsc <- exists("gdsc_raw") && is.data.frame(gdsc_raw) && nrow(gdsc_raw) > 0
have_ctrp <- exists("have_ctrp") && isTRUE(have_ctrp)
have_prism <- exists("prism_expr") && nrow(prism_expr) > 0

if (exists("expr_target") && nrow(expr_target) > 0) {
  t2 <- expr_target %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$stem_like_subtype, .data$stem_like_group) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(N_cohort = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")
  if (exists("pair_df") && nrow(pair_df) > 0) {
    t2 <- t2 %>%
      dplyr::left_join(
        pair_df %>% dplyr::count(.data$lineage_group, name = "N_PRISM"),
        by = c("stem_like_subtype" = "lineage_group")
      )
  }
  knitr::kable(t2, caption = "Table 2. Cross-platform integration: cohort lines by stem-like subtype (PRISM/GDSC/CTRP loaded in upstream 01 child when cache present).")
}

sources_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
  Source = c(STEMAI_SEEN_SOURCES, STEMAI_UNSEEN_SOURCES),
  Partition = c(rep("seen", length(STEMAI_SEEN_SOURCES)), rep("unseen", length(STEMAI_UNSEEN_SOURCES))),
  Role = c(
    "Expression, CRISPR, PRISM",
    "Dose-response LNIC50",
    "Dose-response AAC",
    "Methylation strata",
    "Patient tumor RNA signatures",
    "AML patient RNA",
    "Literature triangulation"
  )
)
knitr::kable(sources_tbl, caption = "Open-source input map (PowerPoint-aligned).")
```
